name: Zanshi no Dizaia
source:
On the day the world died, people stopped wishing for anything.

Suddenly, the world came under the rule of non-human beings known as the Armored Beasts.
Humans, who once ruled the world, were oppressed by them and stripped of their rights.
Hachi is a young man kept as a pet by one of the Armored Beasts, Galladre.
He served the [Armored Beasts] of his own free will, without complaint about his hellish daily life. One night, a turning point arrives for Hachi, who had been living each day without any desires.

He is taken away from [Gyaradre] by Arival, the leader of the Resistance seeking to liberate the world, and comes to know the outside world for the first time.

And for the first time in his life—he discovers his own desires.
translation:
在世界灭亡的那一天，人们不再祈求任何东西。

突然间，世界被称为装甲兽的非人类统治。
曾经统治世界的人类，却遭到他们的压迫，被剥夺了权利。
八公是一位年轻人，被铠甲兽之一加拉德雷当作宠物饲养。
他自愿侍奉【铠兽】，对地狱般的日常生活毫无怨言。一天晚上，对于每天过着没有任何欲望的八公来说，转折点到来了。

他被寻求解放世界的抵抗组织领袖阿里瓦尔从[Gyaradre]带走，第一次认识了外面的世界。

他有生以来第一次发现了自己的欲望。
